cards.front: What are the key assumptions of Classical Laminate Theory?
cards.back: Kirchhoff hypothesis (normals remain straight & perpendicular), linear elasticity per ply, perfect inter-ply bonding, plane-stress state, small deflections, thin laminate.

cards.front: State the ABD constitutive relation in CLT.
Give the summation formula for the extensional stiffness matrix A.
Give the summation formula for the coupling stiffness matrix B.
Give the summation formula for the bending stiffness matrix D.
What physical behavior does a non-zero B matrix produce?
cards.back: Extension-bending and shear-twisting coupling: in-plane forces induce curvatures and moments induce mid-plane strains.

cards.front: Why is B identically zero for any symmetric laminate?
cards.back: Ply contributions above and below the mid-plane are equal in stiffness and opposite in signed z-distance, so they cancel.
